findings.problem: «निर्देश निभाना» is not a Hindi collocation: निभाना takes a duty, promise or role, while instructions take «पालन». The sentence is understandable but reads translated; it is error copy, so the register should be clean.

findings.problem: The only three-dot ellipsis in the catalogue: the other six ellipsis occurrences in this file (in four values) use U+2026 («…»), and the en source's ASCII dots are not a locale decision. Cosmetic, no meaning change.

observations.topic: Wave-A minor HI-WA-1 re-judged, not carried
observations.detail: Receipt wa-hi-3acece16f468 recorded «एजेंट सौंपें / टीम सौंपें» (header chip tooltips and their aria twins) as a minor idiom improvement toward «असाइन करें». Re-read here against the whole hi corpus: सौंपना is this product's assign verb in 21 shipped key-values (20 distinct values), including ui.projects… «टीम या एजेंट बाद में सौंपें।», ui.settings… «पहले से {label} को सौंपा गया।», the work-over-session strings), while «असाइन» occurs once, in a shortcut-capture refuser. Changing these four values would create a term split rather than remove one, so this audit does not re-raise it; the wave-A entry remains history on its own receipt.

observations.topic: Placeholder order is a locale adaptation, not a parity break
observations.detail: Six messages place the same named arguments in a different sentence order than en: checkpoint.turn / jump_agent / jump_agent_unnamed / jump_user / jump_user_no_clock («{total} में से टर्न {turn}»), composer.status.loop_progress_of_turns («{total} में से {completed} टर्न») and session_status.not_signed_in («{label} में साइन-इन नहीं है»). Names, types, styles (::group-off, number) and select/plural trees are identical; Hindi verb-final order requires the reordering, and the two wave receipts already read these bytes. Not a finding.

observations.topic: Split strings compose with their link/prefix neighbours
observations.detail: Rendered by concatenation: provider/model/rate_limit/invalid_key/unavailable/schema before+link+after and the question_dock {prefix} family read continuously, and the two whitespace differences flagged mechanically are required joins (leading space in invalid_key.after after the settings link, trailing space in hint.prefix). No double or missing space at the joins.

observations.topic: hub_update.update_all_label count referent checked in code
observations.detail: First read suggested the agents/teams/skills branches («सभी {count} एजेंट अपडेट करें») could state a wrong count because they drop the noun «updates». Going one step further: hubAvailableCount() in src/renderer/src/shared/api/local-operator/hub-updates.ts:379 counts ITEMS of the kind whose mark is available (one update per item), so {count} equals the number of agents/teams/skills being updated. The wording names the same number naturally; it is not a factual error, so it is not counted.
